You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 44 of 50 (script duration 70.5 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
...
E34: Put on trial for witchcraft and poisoning, Lady Juliana stands proud and defiant in the prisoner's dock, refusing to renounce her mother's herbal medicine even after her coerced maid gives false testimony against her.
E35: Fleeing her captivity through a secret passage, Alexander's elderly mother treks through a bitter blizzard to a secluded cabin, where she tearfully reunites with her presumed-dead son and learns the horrifying conspiracy behind his supposed demise.
E36: Learning from his mother that Rupert and Catherine framed Juliana for witchcraft and sentenced her to death right after their upcoming wedding, Alexander vows to return from the dead and reclaim everything stolen from him.
E37: As Rupert and Catherine issue wedding invitations paired with Juliana's public execution decree to terrorize the county, Juliana endures starvation in the dungeon, refusing to break her spirit.
E38: A compassionate guard secretly feeds Juliana bread in the dungeon, strengthening her resolve to protect Alexander's secrets just as distant wedding bells signal the start of Rupert's nuptials and her impending execution.
E39: While Alexander's loyal men infiltrate and neutralize the royal guards stationed outside the cathedral, Alexander sheds his rugged disguise, dons his ducal regalia, and marches forth to reclaim his house and rescue Juliana.
E40: High society gathers at the grand cathedral for Rupert and Catherine's lavish wedding, while the conspirators ensure every exit is sealed to seal Juliana's execution—unaware that Alexander's retribution is already at their gates.
E41: At the height of Catherine and Rupert's lavish wedding, Juliana is paraded before high society in chains to be publicly disgraced—until a deafening explosion shatters the cathedral entrance, heralding Alexander's vengeful assault.
E42: Emerging from the smoke of the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert, wins the loyalty of the royal guards, and is proclaimed the rightful Duke of Ashburn by his weeping mother.
E43: When Rupert frantically orders Alexander's arrest, the royal guards refuse and salute the true Duke, before damning Crown intelligence documents expose Rupert and Lord Sterling's treasonous plot.
Direct lead-in to E44: Picks up immediately from Episode 43's cliffhanger at the church side exit; Lord Sterling's escape is blocked by the Police Constable, leading into the downfall of the conspirators.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: As Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown, Catherine pleads with Alexander for their past love, only to be coldly rejected as he walks toward his chained bride, Juliana.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-3.2] SCREEN: Low-angle shot framing the towering stone archway as a stern Police Constable steps through the heavy open doors, blocking Lord Sterling's path.
[L002 0.0-3.2] ACTION: The Police Constable strides firmly down the steps and halts right in front of Lord Sterling, holding his ground.
[L003 3.2-8.6] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of the Police Constable towering over Lord Sterling.
[L004 3.3-8.2] POLICE CONSTABLE (Authoritative, Stern): "Lord Henry Sterling, you are under arrest by order of the Crown."
[L005 8.6-11.4] SCREEN: Close-up on Lord Sterling's trembling, indignant face.
[L006 9.1-11.2] LORD STERLING (Snarls, Outraged): "You have no authority!"
[L007 11.4-13.8] SCREEN: Close-up on the Constable's black-gloved hands holding out a thick, red-ribboned dossier stamped with the Crown's royal wax seal.
[L008 11.4-13.2] POLICE CONSTABLE (Cold, Definite): "I have more than enough."
[L009 13.8-16.4] SCREEN: Wide shot of the ruined nave littered with rubble as royal redcoat guards surround the aisle, forcing Rupert down onto his knees.
[L010 14.0-16.4] ACTION: A royal redcoat guard firmly forces Rupert down into the stone dust.
[L011 14.0-16.8] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Frantic, Shouting): "Get your hands off me! Catherine!"
[L012 16.4-19.4] SCREEN: Close-up on Rupert struggling fiercely against the white-gloved grip of the guard pinning his shoulder.
[L013 17.4-19.3] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Screaming): "Do something!"
[L014 19.4-22.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up on Catherine beneath her bridal veil, looking downward in conflicted silence.
[L015 21.8-24.4] ACTION: Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.
[L016 22.0-24.4] SCREEN: Close-up on Catherine's gloved hand tightening into a fist.
[L017 24.4-27.8] SCREEN: Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.
[L018 25.2-28.0] CATHERINE (Shaken, Tearful): "Alexander... I thought you had died."
[L019 27.8-31.2] SCREEN: Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.
[L020 28.4-31.0] CATHERINE (Choked, Weeping): "Do you know what this did to me?"
[L021 31.2-32.4] SCREEN: Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.
[L022 31.2-32.4] CATHERINE (Pleading): "I mourned you."
[L023 32.4-34.0] SCREEN: Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.
[L024 32.4-34.0] CATHERINE (Vulnerable, Trembling): "I waited for you."
[L025 34.0-35.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.
[L026 34.2-38.8] CATHERINE (Heartbroken): "For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea."
[L027 35.8-38.8] SCREEN: Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.
[L028 38.8-41.2] SCREEN: Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.
[L029 38.9-41.2] CATHERINE (Whispering, Longing): "I never stopped loving you."
[L030 41.2-42.8] ACTION: Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.
[L031 41.2-42.8] SCREEN: Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.
[L032 42.8-46.4] SCREEN: Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.
[L033 44.2-46.4] CATHERINE (Breathless, Hurt): "You don't remember?"
[L034 46.4-49.0] SCREEN: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.
[L035 46.6-48.8] CATHERINE (Desperate, Demanding): "I was supposed to be your Duchess!"
[L036 49.0-51.0] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.
[L037 49.2-51.0] ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable): "You were never my Duchess."
[L038 51.0-53.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.
[L039 51.1-52.8] CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading): "But I loved you!"
[L040 53.0-55.6] SCREEN: Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.
[L041 53.0-55.5] ALEXANDER (Scornful, Biting): "You loved the Duke you thought you would marry."
[L042 55.6-59.0] SCREEN: Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.
[L043 56.2-58.2] CATHERINE (Defiant, Pained): "No!"
[L044 59.0-62.4] SCREEN: Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.
[L045 59.8-62.4] CATHERINE (Passionate, Crying): "I loved you before all this!"
[L046 62.4-63.8] SCREEN: Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.
[L047 62.5-63.4] ALEXANDER (Skeptical, Cutting): "Did you?"
[L048 63.8-65.0] SCREEN: Close-up on Catherine, rendered speechless by his doubt.
[L049 65.0-67.8] SCREEN: Tilt-up shot starting from heavy iron chains resting on the wooden floor up to the shackled wrists of Juliana dressed in her rustic grey gown.
[L050 67.8-69.6] SCREEN: Wide shot from behind Catherine as Alexander turns his back on her and walks resolutely down the rubble-strewn aisle toward Juliana standing in chains at the doorway.
[L051 68.0-69.6] ACTION: Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.
[L052 69.6-70.1] SCREEN: Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.
[L053 70.1-70.5] SCREEN: Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.
[L054 70.1-70.4] CATHERINE (Gasping, Incredulous): "Her?!"

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}

YOUR PREVIOUS ANSWER:
{"candidates": [{"title": "The Cold Rejection", "segments": [{"start_line": "L029", "end_line": "L033"}, {"start_line": "L049", "end_line": "L054"}], "hook_line": "L029", "hook": "Catherine's desperate plea for love creates an emotional hook that is immediately met with a harsh rejection.", "hook_quote": "I never stopped loving you.", "cliffhanger_line": "L054", "cliffhanger": "Catherine realizes Alexander has chosen her rival, leaving the viewer shocked by the twist.", "cliffhanger_quote": "Her?!", "why_it_works": "The emotional rejection and the surprise reveal of the true romantic focus are highly effective.", "setup_needed": "None", "spoiler_risk": "low", "self_score": 10}]}

Some of your candidates broke the hard rules. Code computed these problems:
- "The Cold Rejection": total duration 13.0 s is outside 20-60 s

Return the same JSON shape again with corrected versions of ONLY the rejected candidates (same titles). Fix the boundaries by choosing different line IDs; keep the idea if it is good. Remember: 20-60 s total, hook_line starts within the first 3 s, cliffhanger_line inside the promo near its end, quotes copied exactly. Set episode_summary to "".
